title: Curriculum-Augmented GFlowNets For mRNA Sequence Generation
abstract: arXiv:2510.03811v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop an approach for the de novo synthesis of messenger RNA (mRNA) sequences encoding target proteins. This requires optimizing multiple biological objectives over large combinatorial spaces defined by synonymous codon sequences, a setting where Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods suffer from mode collapse and Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) face sparse rewards over long horizons. To address these challenges, we propose Curriculum-Augmented GFlowNets (CAGFNs), a multi-objective GFlowNet trained with an adaptive length-based curriculum driven by learning progress. In a nutshell, CAGFNs learn from progressively harder tasks corresponding to longer target proteins. We evaluate CAGFNs on CodonDesignEnv, a novel codon-level environment that preserves protein identity via dynamic action masking. Our experiments show that CAGFNs achieve competitive or stronger Pareto-front coverage and diversity while converging up to 4 times fas

translated_title: 面向mRNA序列生成的课程增强生成流网络
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一种从头合成编码目标蛋白的信使RNA（mRNA）序列的方法。这需要在由同义密码子序列定义的巨大组合空间上优化多个生物学目标，在这一场景下，强化学习（RL）方法容易遭遇模式崩塌，而生成流网络则面临长时程奖励稀疏的问题。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了课程增强生成流网络，这是一种通过由学习进度驱动的、基于序列长度的自适应课程进行训练的多目标生成流网络。简而言之，CAGFN通过从对应于更长目标蛋白的、难度逐步递增的任务中学习来提升能力。我们在CodonDesignEnv上对CAGFN进行了评估，这是一个通过动态动作掩码保持蛋白一致性的新型密码子级别环境。实验结果表明，CAGFN实现了具有竞争力或更优的帕累托前沿覆盖率与多样性，同时收敛速度最高可提升4倍。
tldr: 该论文提出课程增强生成流网络，利用学习进度驱动的自适应长度课程策略，在新型密码子设计环境中高效生成编码目标蛋白的mRNA序列，实现更优的帕累托前沿覆盖与多样性，且收敛速度最高提升4倍。
